description:
From: GC. Approved by the user 2026-11-24 ("proceed", relayed by GC). A page for the user comes before building.

Today: Process.list_retention_attempts/_hits and struct_retention_attempts/_hits are per-process counters bumped inline on every reuse attempt (list_reuse.rs:71/97/118 via fn_ctx::bump_process_counter) and in the runtime (ir_runtime.rs:2032), and printed on the exit line. Make Distiller Fast's listing shows two load/add/store per element in json.fz reverse, at [x21+0x578] and [x21+0x580].

Change: delete the four process counters, their inline and runtime bumps and the exit-line fields. Count attempts and hits at a per-reuse-site counter and report the sums, the way fz-9x7.37.3 does for allocations.

Done when: no per-element process-counter bump remains in reverse's code; the reported sums equal today's figures on the fixtures that pin them; no pin rises.

comments.text: From: GC. Page approved by the user 2026-11-24, verbatim "approved;": https://claude.ai/artifact/9yNjH7q4xZFuFVwNnRpYhr. Decisions: (1) reuse sites join the existing per-program site table, reuse_site event per site at run end; (2) one counter per outcome, hits and misses, attempts = sum; (3) tuple copy is its own site kind (List|Struct|Tuple), program struct figure sums Struct+Tuple so no pin moves. Builder: GC.

title: Retention statistics are counts per reuse site
